rv.q: What starts as a mordant satire ends in a warm glow of humanist sentiment.

Mr Bean makes mighty fine jokes all along the way – I like Ben’s idea of the perfect bloke-ish death being extravagant suicide on Top Gear – and Stevenson glows like an agreeable firebrand all night, reminding us how rare is her onstage mix of intellectual probity and heart-breaking concern.
The Heretic is a thrillingly funny and satisfying comedy drama.

cn.t: Bean's climate change drama proves provocative and funny, elevated by Juliet Stevenson's superb performance, though its three-hour runtime feels overlong and overstuffed with plot.
